Name: Pocket Shop
Author: Flexix898786
Description:
Description
Pocket Shop lets you buy and sell items from anywhere on the farm, without trekking to town. Press a hotkey to open a tidy general store menu, browse by category (seeds, produce, resources, ores, artisan goods), and sell straight from your inventory — just like the Shipping Bin, but instant and on your terms.
Seed stock automatically rotates with the season, so you'll always see what's actually plantable right now instead of last season's leftovers cluttering the shelves. Sell prices get a configurable bonus (10% by default) as a reward for the convenience.
Built entirely on Stardew's native shop menu, so it looks, sounds, and feels exactly like a real in-game store — no clunky custom UI bolted on top.
Installation instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already, and make sure you can launch the game through it.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it.[/*]
[*]Move the unzipped
[code]PocketShop[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]That's it — no further setup is required for the mod to work.
Main features
[list]
[*][b]Open a shop anywhere[/b] — press a customizable hotkey to bring up a category picker, no need to visit town[/*]
[*][b]Buy and sell[/b] — purchase seeds, produce, resources, ores/gems, and artisan goods, or sell anything from your inventory[/*]
[*][b]Seasonal seed rotation[/b] — the seed shop automatically updates each season to only stock what's currently plantable[/*]
[*][b]Configurable sell bonus[/b] — adjust how much extra (or less) you earn selling through the shop compared to the Shipping Bin[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla-styled UI[/b] — uses the game's own shop menu, so it matches the rest of Stardew Valley perfectly[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu support[/b] — change your hotkey and sell bonus in-game if you have GMCM installed, no file editing needed[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — only needed if you want to change settings from an in-game menu instead of editing
[code]config.json[/code]directly[/*]
[/list]
